features.title: Explicit automated lifecycle and depot/mainline handoff
features.verification: state/interlock/fault matrix, timing and independent safety assessment
features.limits: Offline contract only; actual TCMS/ATP/ATO and GoA4 evidence open

features.title: Diverse obstacle detection and critical-channel independence
features.verification: coverage, latency, common-cause fault injection and independent wiring/power audit
features.limits: CCTV is not a qualified obstacle detector; new sensor allocations and safety case required

features.title: Bearing, brake, speed and suspension condition monitoring
features.verification: sensor frame/calibration, plausibility, failure timing and holdout observations
features.limits: No supplier warning thresholds or real measurements available

features.title: Traction and regenerative-energy comparison on a fixed duty
features.verification: energy balance, motor/inverter/pack limits and measured baseline
features.limits: Manufacturer saving claims not adopted; efficiencies in examples are declared assumptions

features.title: HVAC zoning, airflow, filtration and roof thermal load
features.verification: thermal/airflow/condensation/maintenance tests under approved ambient duty
features.limits: No antibacterial performance claim without product and maintenance evidence

features.title: Sealed, maintainable doors and compatible acoustic isolation
features.verification: door interlocks, obstruction/water tests, acoustic/fire data and removal trial
features.limits: Seals/damping cannot obstruct egress or substitute for measured noise evidence

features.title: Modular lightweight parts with repair and material passports
features.limits: No envelope-density mass inference or unqualified carbon/strength benefit

features.title: Datum fixtures, qualified joins and recorded fastening
features.verification: fixture survey, WPS/cure/torque trace and independent first article
features.limits: Reference fixture and generated records are not production release
